nodes.label: Multi-Agent Dashboard
nodes.description: Real-time monitoring and control interface for opencode AI coding agents. Next.js web app that displays all running sessions, streams live output, and manages agent lifecycles from a single browser window.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 (Turbopack)
nodes.description: React framework with App Router and Turbopack bundler. Route handler params are Promises in v16.

nodes.label: React 19
nodes.description: UI library used for component rendering.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.description: CSS framework using @theme inline in CSS (not tailwind.config.ts). Colors use OKLCH with color-mix() for opacity. No config file; PostCSS plugin required.

nodes.label: TypeScript 6
nodes.description: Type-safe language with strict mode. Rejects .ts/.tsx extensions in imports unless allowImportingTsExtensions is enabled.

nodes.label: Zustand v5
nodes.description: Client-side state management library. Sessions stored as Map<string, AgentCardData> with immutable update pattern.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui v2
nodes.description: Headless UI component library providing Button, Badge, Input, Select, modal, and other primitives. Installed via the Gridcn registry.

nodes.label: The Gridcn
nodes.description: Tron-themed shadcn registry providing Tron cyan theme, data-card, hud-corner-frame, circuit-background, and GridScan components. Poseidon blue theme overrides CSS :root variables.

nodes.label: lucide-react
nodes.description: Icon library used for UI icons throughout the dashboard.

nodes.label: @opencode-ai/sdk v1.16
nodes.description: Official TypeScript SDK for the opencode server. Provides session management, event subscription, agent listing, model listing, and config retrieval. Its package.json has 'type': 'module'.

nodes.label: Opencode Server
nodes.description: Backend server running at localhost:4096, started via 'opencode serve'. Hosts session data, event streams, agents, and provider models. Must be running before dashboard starts.

nodes.label: OPENCODE_SERVER_URL
nodes.description: Environment variable for the opencode server base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:4096.

nodes.label: remark
nodes.description: Markdown processing library used for rendering markdown in the terminal pane output.

nodes.label: remark-html
nodes.description: Remark plugin that converts markdown AST to HTML strings. Used alongside remark for terminal output rendering.

nodes.label: Radix UI
nodes.description: Headless UI primitives library. Select.Item component reserves empty string value for clear/placeholder state.

nodes.label: Context7
nodes.description: Documentation retrieval tool used to find up-to-date library docs, API references, and code examples. Recommended for any library/framework/API questions.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.description: Knowledge graph tool generating god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships at graphify-out/. Provides query, path, and explain subcommands.

nodes.label: Data Flow Pattern
nodes.description: Browser → Next.js API route → lib/opencode.ts (SDK client) → opencode server on :4096. No direct browser-to-opencode calls to avoid CORS issues.

nodes.label: CORS Avoidance Pattern
nodes.description: All SDK calls are proxied through Next.js API routes server-side, preventing browser CORS errors when connecting to the opencode server.

nodes.label: SSE Streaming (Primary)
nodes.description: Server-Sent Events used as the primary real-time transport via /api/events proxy to opencode's event stream. Client uses client.event.subscribe().

nodes.label: Polling Fallback (10s)
nodes.description: 10-second interval polling as fallback when SSE fails. Waits 5 seconds before activating to let auto-reconnect try first. Skips updateSession when title hasn't changed.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Params Pattern
nodes.description: In Next.js 16, route handler params is a Promise and must be destructured with await. Direct property access causes TypeError.

nodes.label: Turbopack Import Rules
nodes.description: Do not use @/ path aliases (in tsconfig but not resolved by Turbopack). Do not include .ts/.tsx extensions in imports (TypeScript 6 rejects them). Always use relative imports.

nodes.label: Immutable Map Pattern
nodes.description: Zustand sessions stored as Map<string, AgentCardData>. Every mutation creates a new Map (immutable pattern) to trigger re-renders.

nodes.label: Zustand Narrow Selectors
nodes.description: State updates trigger re-renders in all useAppStore() subscribers. Use narrow selectors to avoid unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.label: Session Model/Agent Extraction
nodes.description: Session model and agent are extracted from messages (not session metadata). Uses findLast for model, find for agent.

nodes.label: Connected Models Filter
nodes.description: /api/models only returns models from providers.connected (configured/authenticated providers). Not all known providers are returned.

nodes.label: Implementation Specification v1.0
nodes.description: REQUIREMENT.md document specifying goals, user flows, technical design, and implementation plan for the Multi-Agent Dashboard. Dated June 5, 2025.

nodes.label: R-01: Dashboard Session List
nodes.description: Dashboard lists all active opencode sessions as cards using client.session.list(). Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-02: Card Metadata Display
nodes.description: Each card shows agent name, session ID, current prompt, and status badge. Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-03: Live Streaming Output
nodes.description: Live streaming output per agent rendered in scrollable terminal pane via SSE or session subscribe. Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-04: Send Prompt Input
nodes.description: Send Prompt input on each card submits to session via client.session.prompt(). Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-05: Terminate Session
nodes.description: Terminate button calls client.session.abort() and removes card on success. Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-06: Create New Session
nodes.description: New Session modal with agent name, model dropdown, and initial prompt calling client.session.create(). Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-07: Auto-refresh via SSE
nodes.description: Auto-refresh and real-time updates via SSE event stream with polling fallback. Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-08: Status Indicators
nodes.description: Status indicators per session: Idle, Running, Error, Done derived from event stream. Priority: Must Have.

nodes.label: R-12: Filter/Search Sessions
nodes.description: Client-side filter and search by session name or status. Priority: Should Have.

nodes.label: R-13: Dark Mode UI
nodes.description: Dark mode UI using Tailwind dark: classes. Priority: Should Have.

nodes.label: Flow 1: Monitor Running Agents
nodes.description: User opens dashboard, app fetches sessions via SDK, renders cards, subscribes to event streams, status badges update automatically.

nodes.label: Flow 2: Send Follow-up Prompt
nodes.description: User types prompt into agent card input, clicks Send, app calls session.prompt(), response streams into terminal pane below.

nodes.label: Flow 3: Create New Agent Session
nodes.description: User clicks + New Agent button, modal opens with Agent Name/Model/Prompt fields, app calls session.create() then session.prompt(), new card appears.

nodes.label: Flow 4: Terminate Agent Session
nodes.description: User clicks terminate button on agent card, confirmation dialog appears, on confirm app calls abort, card fades out and is removed.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Foundation
nodes.description: Setup Next.js, install @opencode-ai/sdk zustand shadcn/ui, configure lib/opencode.ts, create API route GET /api/sessions, verify server connection.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Core UI
nodes.description: Build AgentGrid/AgentCard layout, TerminalPane with live SSE, useSessionStream hook, Zustand store wiring, StatusBadge, PromptInput integration.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Control & Polish
nodes.description: NewSessionModal, terminate button, collapse/expand cards, filter/search bar, dark mode toggle, error states, SSE reconnect, README.

nodes.label: Message Data Model
nodes.description: SDK Message type with fields: id, role (user|assistant), parts (Part[]), info (MessageInfo).

nodes.label: Part Data Model
nodes.description: SDK Part type with fields: type (text|tool-invocation|...), optional text string.

nodes.label: AgentCard UI Model
nodes.description: Local UI state with fields: sessionId, agentName, status, messages[], isExpanded, isPinned.

nodes.label: AppState UI Model
nodes.description: Zustand store shape: sessions (Map<id, AgentCard>), filter (string), isConnected (bool).

nodes.label: SDK Package Module Type Gotcha
nodes.description: The @opencode-ai/sdk package has 'type': 'module' in its package.json. Must not be added to root package.json or it breaks CJS configs.

nodes.label: Select.Item Empty Value Gotcha
nodes.description: Radix Select.Item cannot have value='' — empty string is reserved for clear/placeholder state.

nodes.label: useState Async Default Gotcha
nodes.description: useState(default) only captures initial mount value. When defaults arrive async (agent/model from messages), use useEffect to sync.

nodes.label: ECONNREFUSED Build Gotcha
nodes.description: Build fails with ECONNREFUSED on API routes during static generation when opencode server is not running. Routes still compile — this is expected.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ Knowledge Graph

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.description: Graphify subcommand for asking codebase questions — returns a scoped subgraph. Recommended first step for codebase questions when graph.json exists.

nodes.label: graphify path
nodes.description: Graphify subcommand for exploring relationships between two entities. Returns a scoped subgraph.

nodes.label: graphify explain
nodes.description: Graphify subcommand for explaining focused concepts. Returns a scoped subgraph.

nodes.label: graphify update
nodes.description: Graphify subcommand to keep the graph current after code modifications. AST-only, no API cost.

nodes.label: graphify-out/wiki/index.md
nodes.description: Wiki index file for broad navigation. Should be used instead of raw source browsing when it exists.

nodes.label: graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.description: Broad architecture review document for the knowledge graph. Should be read only when query/path/explain don't surface enough context.
